W.note: Overshoot bloom and a drifting veil feel airy, but it animates box-shadow, filter, background-position and letter-spacing per hover, which is costly for a real page, and the plain shop layout is only average.

X.note: The halo is restrained but clearly lit, only transform and opacity animate, the focus ring and reduced-motion handling are solid, and the dark states grid gives it the clearest hierarchy.

Y.note: Delayed bloom and the four distinct curve presets are the most thoughtful motion work, but backdrop-filter and blurred halos cost render time, and the garish gradient stage and tuning panel crowd the page.

Z.note: The pearly veil sweep and slow haze exit are the most dreamlike, with a playful release spring, but letter-spacing and box-shadow transitions cost layout and paint, and the mismatched pink and cyan buttons weaken the palette.
